modules.core: Data model schema — get, list, describe, load, and delete data models; resolve by ID or title; list elasticubes; export/import a full schema definition for cross-environment migration.
modules.connections: Connection management — get, update, and create data source connections; generate connection payloads for supported providers.
modules.build: Schema provisioning — create data models, datasets, and tables; deploy a data model with configurable build behavior.
modules.security: Row-level security — get, update, and bulk-add datasecurity rules that restrict data access per user or group; retrieve raw, unprocessed rules for round-tripping between environments.
modules.shares: Data model access — get and add share entries (users and groups) with READ, USE, or EDIT permission levels; get/replace raw (partyId-keyed) permissions for cross-environment migration.
modules.data: Data retrieval — query table contents via SQL; get row counts per table across an entire data model (``get_data``, ``get_row_count``).
modules.perspectives: Perspectives — metadata-only views over a root model that keep a subset of its tables and columns; list them, create one from table and column names, delete one, and analyze what a model's dashboards use (plus join, custom-column and custom-table dependencies) to know what a perspective must keep.
